title: transcript-record
description: One detected meeting artifact — a transcript, or a Gemini notes file — as the detection cycle (m3) emits it from a Drive sweep. Shape only: how transcripts are detected or paired is goal.md's business, never this file's.

title.description: meeting title as the source carries it; may be empty

start-time.description: meeting start, RFC 3339 with UTC offset

participants.description: participant display names as the source carries them; may be empty

metadata-handle.description: optional authoritative metadata linkage, present when the source exposes one

ref.description: opaque reference into the authoritative system; consumers never parse it

account.description: Google account label; the labels themselves are data (e.g. 'pessoal', 'tecer'), never schema

source.description: which pipeline produced the file: 'meet' and 'tactiq' are verbatim transcripts; 'gemini-notes' is a model-written notes file (Notes by Gemini) — a supplementary source, never a transcript

drive-ref.description: opaque reference to one Drive object (file or folder); compared for equality only, never parsed, never treated as a filesystem path
